reports.title: Betroffene User
reports.query: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIOLATES]->(:SoDConflict {runId:'current'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS User

reports.title: Aktive (nicht sleeping)
reports.query: MATCH (f:SoDConflict {runId:'current'}) WHERE NOT f.userSleeping RETURN count(f) AS Aktiv

reports.title: SAP_ALL-Inhaber
reports.query: MATCH (u:User {dataset:'sachsenenergie'})-[:HAS_PROFILE]->(:Profile {id:'SAP_ALL'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS SAP_ALL

reports.title: Top-Regeln (betroffene User)
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:VIOLATES]->(f:SoDConflict {runId:'current'})-[:BASED_ON]->(r:SoDRule)
RETURN r.id AS Regel, r.criticality AS Kritikalitaet, r.criticalityRank AS Rang, left(r.description,55) AS Beschreibung, count(DISTINCT u) AS User
ORDER BY Rang DESC, User DESC

reports.title: Konfliktpfade (very-high): User → Konflikt → Regel
reports.query:
MATCH p=(u:User)-[:VIOLATES]->(f:SoDConflict {runId:'current'})-[:BASED_ON]->(r:SoDRule)
WHERE f.criticality = 'very-high'
RETURN p LIMIT 40
